method: Post hoc, Amendment 7. The judges applied two novelty rules (S5b entity-level, S5c fact-level). The primary rule is now fact-level: an entity is new when the KB's leaves (not _scratch/) don't record the fact the list asks for: that the product answers from the web, and with what (S5b), or that the company names Exa (S5c). The entity-level rule (new only if the company appears nowhere in the KB's leaves) is reported as a sensitivity. Under both rules, _scratch/ research notes don't count as the KB.

fact_level_to_novel.S5b-e20: Aisera: the only KB mention is a _scratch/ partner list; no leaf records its Public Search on Google.
fact_level_to_novel.S5b-e12: Snowflake Cortex Agents and Snowflake Intelligence: the leaves record Cortex Agents only as a channel for Exa's own integration; that Snowflake's built-in web search runs on Brave is only in _scratch/.
fact_level_to_novel.S5b-e1: Grok Business and Enterprise: the xAI leaf covers Grok's API web search, not the workplace product that searches Google Drive and the web.

entity_level_to_known.S5c-e24: Apollo.io is in the KB as a competitor (competitive/b2b-data-providers.md).
entity_level_to_known.S5c-e20: Gamma is in the KB as a Firecrawl logo (competitive/firecrawl.md:59).
entity_level_to_known.S5c-e12: Jan is in the KB as a Serper integration (competitive/serper.md:73).
entity_level_to_known.S5c-e6: Novita is in the KB as another customer's subprocessor (customer-stories/anara-scientific-paper-discovery.md:68).

S5b-e5.reason: GitHub Copilot matched 'supermemory Company Brain' only because that exclusion's URL is on github.com, a shared host.

S5b-e26.reason: On the exclusion list under that name; the key (chatgpt.com) didn't match the listed URL.

S5c-e25.reason: On the exclusion list; the key was about.google.

entity_level_to_novel.S5b-e20: Aisera appears only in a _scratch/ partner list, and _scratch/ doesn't count as the KB under either rule.
